description: Landed-cost estimate (ERP-D-015: before receipt the purchase order header is an estimate): one host cycle of the purchase-order Portal relations and the AGENTS site's '/Ontology UseCases' containers (examples/landed_cost_estimate_host.live-check.json, GET only), then every PurchaseOrder the reader can read with a Portal header status (plx.find, every page) that is open by the one PO status definition (operating.po_status: the header word with the order's own lines' summed quantities read through plx.object and plx.around; an unmapped word, unread lines or a line in another unit is unknown, never open; estimate.po_classes counts each listed record by class and unknown reason; the first 500 open ones investigated) investigated plx.investigate landed_cost offline as staff:operations with the runner principal svc:landed-cost-verifier (the one principal the host config grants the store markings: an estimate is stated only for a reader whose scope is proven to show every line of the purchase order). Per open purchase order the report reads, as codes only, whether a labelled estimate (operating.landed_cost.ESTIMATE_LABEL) is stated, its freight source (header shipping estimate or one usable forwarder quote) and its assumption kinds (header duty pro-rated, a person-recorded duty rate, the Portal default tariffRate 0.065 with its range), and the missing inputs the estimate names with who can give them (FIN, PROC). It passes when the listing is complete (a scan the tool says is capped has no true open count: estimate.open_pos_total is null, estimate.listing_reason names why, and the check fails), every listed order is investigated (none past the limit), every one states an estimate or names a missing input with who can answer, every estimate entry is labelled, every assumption is classified and no investigation failed; estimate.with_estimate, estimate.with_named_missing_input and three estimate.samples are recorded. No open purchase order readable: blocked (source_gap), never a pass. stdout holds counts and codes only: never a PO number, an id or an amount.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it. Module test is injected-transport: verify/tests/test_live_verify_landed_cost_estimate.py runs this spec's own command in-process over a FakeWorkbench (the SYNTHETIC packaging fixture, one open purchase order given a header shipping estimate) and an injected Graph transport with an empty use-case folder, then replays the report through verify live_verify run_spec: pass with one estimate and named missing inputs; Cancel (any case) closed, a Complete header over partly received lines open, Pending over fully received lines closed; blocked (source_gap) when no purchase order is open; fail for a reader without the store markings (no estimate value, ESTIMATE_READ_SCOPE_UNPROVEN names no person); N=1/10/61 open orders each investigated once; past a limit the check fails (not_investigated); a listing scan cut at its per-call cap resumes through its cursor to every open order (complete), and one cut without a cursor fails with open_pos_total null.
